title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Numbers 2: how the tribes of Israel camped around the Tent of Meeting and in which order they set out.

questions.text: Where were the children of Israel to encamp?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they were to encamp by their standards around the Tent of Meeting, at a distance from it.

answers.text: Around the Tent of Meeting, at a distance from it
Only on the east side of the Tent of Meeting
Inside the court of the Tent of Meeting
In one long line behind the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: Which camp was on the east side, toward the sunrise?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says the standard of the camp of Judah was on the east side toward the sunrise.

questions.text: Which tribe encamped next to Judah?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says the tribe of Issachar encamped next to Judah, with Nethanel the son of Zuar as prince.

questions.text: When was the camp of Judah to set out?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says the camp of Judah, one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, would set out first.

questions.text: Which camp was on the south side?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the standard of the camp of Reuben was on the south side.

questions.text: Where was the camp of the Levites when the Tent of Meeting set out?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says the Tent of Meeting would set out with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps.

answers.text: In the middle of the camps
At the front of all the camps
At the very back of all the camps
Beside the camp of Judah only

questions.text: Who was the prince of the children of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 names Elishama the son of Ammihud as prince of Ephraim, on the west side.

questions.text: Which camp was to set out last?
questions.explanation: Verse 31 says the camp of Dan, one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred, would set out last by their standards.

questions.text: What was the total of all who were counted of the camps?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 says all who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

answers.text: One hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred
Six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty

questions.text: Who were not counted among the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 33 says the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
